title: Owain_Evans
summary:
Owain Evans (pronounced "Oh-wine") is an AI alignment researcher leading a research group in Berkeley and affiliated with Oxford University. He is the founder and director of Truthful AI, a research non-profit that studies situational awareness, deception, and hidden reasoning in language models.

Evans holds a PhD from MIT and was previously at the Future of Humanity Institute (FHI) at Oxford. He is an affiliate of the Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI) at UC Berkeley and serves on the Board of Directors at Ought and Constellation.

His notable research contributions include TruthfulQA, a benchmark for measuring whether language models generate truthful answers, and The Reversal Curse, which demonstrated that LLMs trained on "A is B" fail to learn "B is A," published at ICLR 2024. He also co-authored "How to catch an AI liar: Lie detection in black-box LLMs by asking unrelated questions," also published at ICLR 2024. His recent work on emergent misalignment, showing that training large language models on narrow tasks can lead to broad misalignment, was published in Nature in 2026.

Evans was selected as the 2025 Hinton Lecturer, delivering three lectures on AI Safety aimed at a general audience in Toronto, hosted by Geoffrey Hinton. He has stated that more resources need to be directed toward AI safety rather than focusing solely on making AI as powerful as possible. He offers the Astra Fellowship, providing 6 months of funding with visas for non-US applicants to work on AI safety research in Berkeley.
